en: • From "Mobile Suit Gundam UC", an SS aircraft with "sleeves" appears.
• Reproduce the rich equipment unique to Gila Zulu. Seals have been added, making it even more heavily equipped.
• Includes wrists for rifle, saber, and open hand.
